name: Bellows Harrier

provenance.brief: An original ground-walking winged sentinel with articulated hands and independently owned braced membranes; secondary motion uses the same classic native rig, not a preview-only deformation.

design_rationale: A filter-masked, copper-braced bellows creature learns appendage ownership and aggressive preparation from complex humanoids. Grounded legs, planar industrial membranes and a fan crest create a separate silhouette without demonic horns, spear or recognizable equipment layout.
